format: Traditional freestanding restaurant with drive-thru (ground lease scenario)

invest.quote: The total investment for a freestanding traditional restaurant ranges from $814,400 to $2,039,250, for an endcap traditional restaurant ranges from $805,310 to $1,423,750, and for a drive-thru focused freestanding restaurant ranges from $1,069,100 to $2,015,750. This includes $40,000 that must be paid to us.

fee.quote: For a single traditional Taco John's Restaurant, we currently charge an Initial Franchise Fee (...) of $40,000, payable in full when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: Military Service Incentive: $0 for first Restaurant of a U.S. veteran with 50% or more service-connected disability rating, $24,000 for first Restaurant of a qualified U.S. veteran, $28,000 for second and additional. Multi-Unit Incentive (new franchisees): $32,000 (2 Restaurants), $28,000 (3 or 4), $24,000 (5 or more). Non-traditional: $15,000. ADA Development Fee $5,000 per Restaurant, credited to the fee. In 2025, fees paid ranged between $20,000 and $25,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty 5% of Net Sales3,6 Currently due on the 20th day of each month

adFund.quote: Advertising and Marketing Fees Currently, 4% of Net Sales for traditional Restaurants (...) We may modify this fee upon 60 days' notice up to a maximum of 4.25% of the Net Sales of a traditional Restaurant
adFund.note: Currently 4% of Net Sales (traditional), up to 4.25%; non-traditional 2%, up to 2.25%. No fixed local advertising percentage stated; local cooperatives required to cease operations by July 2026.

item19.note: Sales only (excluding sales tax); no costs or expenses. Covers 299 of 316 franchised restaurants open at least 12 months; excludes 2 new, 1 tornado-closed, 3 non-traditional, 7 without drive-thru, 4 DT Digital Ole prototypes/earlier concepts, 15 closed in 2025, and company-owned restaurants. 104 (41.9%) met or exceeded the average.

special: Investment assumes a ground lease (deposit plus first three months' rent); land purchase (generally $16 to $45 per square foot) is not included. Non-compliance fees: $1,000 per failed inspection, $1,000 to $3,000 per day for delivery/catering/hours non-compliance, 3% of Net Sales per day for other non-compliance. Franchised system shrinking: -4 (2023), -24 (2024), -17 (2025).
issues: The 'Other Non-Compliance' fee is printed as '3% of Net Sales per day' in the amount column but remarks describe 3% of Net Sales during the non-compliance period. Mystery Shop annual figure assumes 12 monthly shops at $95. Toward-franchisor amount is the cover's $40,000 (initial fee only).
